description.value:
These archaic cassette tapes always have the perfect music for your tastes and the situation you find yourself in. While you listen to them on the included music player, you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks using your key attribute modifier.

Activate—Play Rad Music 1 (auditory, tech)

Frequency once per day

Effect With the click of a button, you listen to the perfect music to get you through a situation. For 1 minute, you gain a +10-foot item bonus to your Speed and deal an additional 1d6 precision damage on any successful Strike.
